name: Kimi ga Yobu, Megiddo no Oka de
original_name: 君が呼ぶ、メギドの丘で
source:
Beigel finds a girl lying unconsciously at the desert. Her name is Rinon. According to her, she came from the edge of the world to stop the God's clock...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
贝格尔在沙漠中发现一名昏迷倒地的少女。她叫莉浓。据她所说，自己从世界尽头而来，是为了让神之时钟停止转动……

[摘自ErogeShop]
